title: First-Order Thermal Cooling
description: Newton's law of cooling for a heated metallic billet immersed in an ambient convective bath using an ACSL DERIVATIVE integrator.
code:
PROGRAM THERMAL_COOLING
  ! First-order lumped-capacitance convective cooling of an aluminum billet
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT tau = 12.5      ! Thermal time constant (s)
    CONSTANT tamb = 293.15   ! Ambient bath temperature (K)
    CONSTANT temp0 = 473.15  ! Initial billet temperature (K)
    CINTERVAL cint = 1.0
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.25
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      dtemp = -(temp - tamb) / tau
      temp = INTEG(dtemp, temp0)
      heat_loss = (temp - tamb) / tau
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 60.0, 'Cooling transient complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_delta_t = temp - tamb
  END
END

title: Damped Spring-Mass Oscillator with Energy Procedural
description: Second-order linear mechanical oscillator with viscous damping and an ACSL PROCEDURAL block computing kinetic, potential, and total mechanical energy.
code:
PROGRAM SPRING_MASS_OSCILLATOR
  ! Damped spring-mass oscillator with energy conservation procedural block
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT m = 2.0         ! Mass (kg)
    CONSTANT c = 0.6         ! Viscous damping coefficient (N*s/m)
    CONSTANT k = 18.0        ! Spring stiffness (N/m)
    CONSTANT x0 = 0.5        ! Initial displacement (m)
    CONSTANT v0 = 0.0        ! Initial velocity (m/s)
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.05
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.01
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      accel = (-k * x - c * v) / m
      v = INTEG(accel, v0)
      x = INTEG(v, x0)

      PROCEDURAL(energy = x, v)
        ke = 0.5 * m * v**2
        pe = 0.5 * k * x**2
        energy = ke + pe
      END
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 10.0, 'Oscillator simulation complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_energy = 0.5 * m * v**2 + 0.5 * k * x**2
  END
END

title: Ballistic Projectile with Aerodynamic Drag and Impact Schedule
description: Two-dimensional nonlinear projectile trajectory with quadratic aerodynamic drag and an ACSL SCHEDULE discrete event capturing ground impact telemetry.
code:
PROGRAM BALLISTIC_PROJECTILE
  ! 2D projectile trajectory with quadratic air drag and scheduled telemetry
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT g = 9.80665     ! Gravitational acceleration (m/s^2)
    CONSTANT cd = 0.47       ! Sphere drag coefficient
    CONSTANT rho = 1.225     ! Sea-level air density (kg/m^3)
    CONSTANT area = 0.015    ! Cross-sectional area (m^2)
    CONSTANT mass = 4.5      ! Projectile mass (kg)
    CONSTANT vx0 = 65.0      ! Initial horizontal velocity (m/s)
    CONSTANT vy0 = 55.0      ! Initial vertical velocity (m/s)
    CONSTANT x0 = 0.0
    CONSTANT y0 = 1.5
    LOGICAL landed = .FALSE.
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.1
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.02
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      speed = SQRT(vx**2 + vy**2)
      drag_k = 0.5 * rho * cd * area / mass
      ax = -drag_k * speed * vx
      ay = -g - drag_k * speed * vy
      vx = INTEG(ax, vx0)
      vy = INTEG(ay, vy0)
      x = INTEG(vx, x0)
      y = INTEG(vy, y0)
      SCHEDULE impact_ev .AT. 8.0
    END

    DISCRETE impact_ev
      landed = .TRUE.
      impact_range = x
      impact_speed = SQRT(vx**2 + vy**2)
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 10.0, 'Trajectory integration complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_range = x
  END
END

title: Chemical CSTR Exothermic Limit Cycle
description: Coupled mass and energy balances for a non-isothermal continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) with Arrhenius reaction kinetics and jacket cooling.
code:
PROGRAM CSTR_LIMIT_CYCLE
  ! Non-isothermal exothermic CSTR with Arrhenius kinetics and jacket cooling
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT q_flow = 100.0   ! Volumetric flow rate (L/min)
    CONSTANT vol = 100.0      ! Reactor volume (L)
    CONSTANT caf = 1.0        ! Feed concentration of species A (mol/L)
    CONSTANT tf = 350.0       ! Feed temperature (K)
    CONSTANT tc = 300.0       ! Cooling jacket temperature (K)
    CONSTANT k0 = 7.2e10      ! Pre-exponential factor (1/min)
    CONSTANT ear = 8750.0     ! Activation energy / R (K)
    CONSTANT dh_rcp = 209.2   ! (-DeltaH) / (rho * Cp) (K*L/mol)
    CONSTANT ua_vrcp = 2.092  ! U*A / (V * rho * Cp) (1/min)
    CONSTANT ca0 = 0.5        ! Initial concentration (mol/L)
    CONSTANT temp0 = 350.0    ! Initial reactor temperature (K)
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.05
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.005
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      rate = k0 * EXP(-ear / temp) * ca
      dca = (q_flow / vol) * (caf - ca) - rate
      dtemp = (q_flow / vol) * (tf - temp) + dh_rcp * rate - ua_vrcp * (temp - tc)
      ca = INTEG(dca, ca0)
      temp = INTEG(dtemp, temp0)
      conversion = (caf - ca) / caf
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 15.0, 'CSTR transient complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_conversion = (caf - ca) / caf
  END
END

title: Pilot-in-the-Loop Pitch Autopilot with Aerodynamic Table
description: Short-period longitudinal aircraft pitch autopilot with ACSL TABLE aerodynamic lookup, elevator actuator lag, discrete flight-computer sampling, and companion aerodynamic dataset.
code:
PROGRAM PITCH_AUTOPILOT
  ! Short-period longitudinal pitch autopilot with TABLE lookup and discrete FCS
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT za = -1.15       ! Normal force derivative Z_alpha (1/s)
    CONSTANT ma = -3.85       ! Pitch stiffness M_alpha (1/s^2)
    CONSTANT mq = -0.92       ! Pitch damping M_q (1/s)
    CONSTANT mde = -12.4      ! Elevator control effectiveness M_delta_e (1/s^2)
    CONSTANT tau_act = 0.05   ! Elevator hydraulic actuator time constant (s)
    CONSTANT kp = 1.8         ! Proportional pitch gain
    CONSTANT kd = 0.45        ! Pitch rate damping gain
    CONSTANT theta_cmd = 0.10 ! Commanded pitch attitude (rad)
    TABLE cm_tab, 1, 5 / -0.2, -0.1, 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.04, 0.02, 0.0, -0.02, -0.04 /
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.02
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.005
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      err_theta = theta_cmd - theta
      de_cmd = kp * err_theta - kd * q_rate
      dde = (de_cmd - delta_e) / tau_act
      delta_e = INTEG(dde, 0.0)

      dalpha = za * alpha + q_rate
      dq = ma * alpha + mq * q_rate + mde * delta_e
      dtheta = q_rate

      alpha = INTEG(dalpha, 0.0)
      q_rate = INTEG(dq, 0.0)
      theta = INTEG(dtheta, 0.0)

      SCHEDULE fcs_tick .AT. 0.5
    END

    DISCRETE fcs_tick
      INTERVAL dt_fcs = 0.1
      logged_theta = theta
      logged_alpha = alpha
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 6.0, 'Autopilot step response complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    steady_err = theta_cmd - theta
  END
END
